@jay_ran89 @Frankie_C_Cat @Citation_Needs @dmunsonATL @HereToRebuild @alfranken @TheDemCoalition You seem to be suggesting "progress being set back" because nobody could find reason to actually believe what Reade was claiming.

IMO progress has been set back by elevating any and all allegations before any serious vetting has been done. So much damage done to #MeToo this way.

@Lynne_MediaLit @VABVOX @Strandjunker And in ways that make Dems look like hypocrites, helped set up possible weaponization of allegations with a terrible precedent for how to proceed, conflation of all offenses, and ultimately damage to the credibility of #MeToo itself.

@the_werle @Lynne_MediaLit @CartyBoston @BriannaWu You cannot blame Mayer for not reporting things she could not check. You just cannot.

And I get to be suspicious of people who were quite happy to report allegations previously but not to have one of the best journalists - with _great_ #MeToo cred - checking what they asserted.

@AcidBurn1986 @JennJenn699 @cynthiasaysboo @DLipartito @MikeSington @ImJeffRussell1 His lawyer? Too funny. Go look up who Debra Katz is.

And Mayer tried to talk to _every accuser_. Most wouldn’t speak with her! Why is that? Who has more credibility to stand up allegations? Mayer excels at investigative work. Wrote on Anita Hill before #MeToo was even a thing.

@BisexualLiberal @PyeattSharon @JohnMashey @careystrombotne @BeriFight @robreiner @BostonGlobe Do you know the best journalists don't just give credence to something they cannot fact-check?

Mayer tried to talk to every single accuser. Most wouldn't speak to HER. Who better than Jane freakin' Mayer to stand up a solid allegation? Mayer did #MeToo before was even a thing.

@brelaung @the_unitron @Dantethecomic @MalcolmNance Most of those accusers wouldn't speak to Jane Mayer - one of the best investigative journalists, and one with serious #MeToo cred, from before that hashtag even existed (see work on Anita Hill).

Part of how they get erased might be their own unwillingness to have claims checked?

@onewonderdog @TuffTiffResists @BustedFlush @MEPFuller @TheRickWilson I knew it then. I mean, it's not like smears and dirty tricks were something new. But #MeToo was SO hot right then and everybody was primed to "believe!" (which I understand but that doesn't mean you can skip serious vetting!) - but when our own (supposed?) leaders don't LEAD...!

@Varkentine @fawfulfan @master_deli The hubris people have to heap crap on one of the best journalists - who had #MeToo red before #MeToo had a name - has truly been something to observe. Some of the worst from men, too, as I think you've observed as well.

@Varkentine @fawfulfan @master_deli *cred. That was supposed to be #MeToo _cred_. I’ll blame autocorrect. :-)

And Mayer runs circles around most. People confident to criticize her fact-finding, having done precisely none of it themselves, so show they don’t want to consider their own sloppy analysis.

@RealiaAmelia Hi, Amelia. That's not accurate. You might want to read the only investigative journalism done on Franken - and by someone who always does serious digging when she works on something. (She wrote deeply on Anita Hill / Clarence Thomas way before #MeToo!)
